name: boat.dev

modes.label: On-demand (flat per size, per second while running)
modes.commit_note: No commit/reserved/always-on discount exists; a 24/7 default sandbox is simply 730 h x $0.036 = $26.28/month.
modes.note: Flat price per size, independent of CPU/RAM utilisation (idle-but-running bills full rate). Stopped = $0 (disk + snapshot free). xlarge needs the $100+ plan and operator allocation on request, and costs 5.56x default for 4x resources (+39% per vCPU). Disk is fixed per size; more disk requires a bigger size. Sandboxes run on standard machines (AMD Ryzen 9 9950X, ~27.7 runs/s); only when standard capacity is temporarily exhausted do they fall back to an older Hetzner cloud VM (~8.9 runs/s, no /dev/kvm) at the same price. No published per-start minimum (docs: 'billing is per second'); boot time billing not documented.

plans.name: Trial
plans.note: 7-day free trial started through Stripe Checkout with a card; one per person/org/payment method/identity. Capped at 25 machine-hours lifetime, 2 concurrent, small/default only, TTL <= 2 h, 5 starts/min, 25/h, 75/day. Unless cancelled before day 7, it converts into the paid plan chosen at checkout (the $20/month floor starts).

plans.name: $20/mo
plans.note: Fee = $20 of machine time, expires at month end (effectively a $20/mo minimum). Overage via $20 credit packs at the same rates (never expire) or auto-refill. Starts 12/min, 60/h, 200/day (create, fork, resume each count). Session unlimited with --no-auto-stop (numeric TTL max 30 d); default TTL 1 h from creation.
plans.seat_note: Organisation plans are billed per seat; concurrency and start limits (and the machine-time credit) scale with seats (docs.boat.dev billing + pricing, main @ 2026-09-28).

plans.name: $100/mo
plans.note: Fee = $100 of machine time, monthly-expiring. Starts 30/min, 210/h, 840/day. Unlocks xlarge (operator allocation on request).
plans.seat_note: Organisation plans are billed per seat; concurrency and start limits (and the machine-time credit) scale with seats (docs.boat.dev billing + pricing, main @ 2026-09-28).

plans.name: $500/mo
plans.note: Fee = $500 of machine time, monthly-expiring. Starts 65/min, 420/h, 1,680/day.
plans.seat_note: Organisation plans are billed per seat; concurrency and start limits (and the machine-time credit) scale with seats (docs.boat.dev billing + pricing, main @ 2026-09-28).

plans.name: $2000/mo
plans.note: Fee = $2,000 of machine time, monthly-expiring. Starts 90/min, 600/h, 2,400/day. More than 2,000 concurrent by agreement (unpublished terms).
plans.seat_note: Organisation plans are billed per seat; concurrency and start limits (and the machine-time credit) scale with seats (docs.boat.dev billing + pricing, main @ 2026-09-28).

free.conditions: card required (Stripe Checkout); one trial per person, organization, payment method and identity; auto-converts to the chosen paid plan after 7 days unless cancelled

features.ip_note: Default datacenter IPs; a custom Chromium fork keeps X, LinkedIn and most sites working (owner-reported)

perf_source: StarSling hpc-sandbox-benchmarks, run 36498291449 (2026-09-29), Node.js V8 Web Tooling p50 at a 4 vCPU / 8 GB target

knobs.label: Idle time billed until TTL auto-stop (× session hours)
knobs.why: boat.dev has no idle auto-stop: a running sandbox bills the full size rate, busy or idle, until `boat stop` or its TTL expires. TTL counts from creation/resume (default 1 h; forks reset to 1 h), so a 20-min task left to the default TTL bills 3x. Default 1 = stopped when work ends; with --no-auto-stop the tail is unbounded (use always-on instead).

caveats: pricemogged is made by boat.dev; boat.dev's numbers come from its public docs and are held to the same standard as every other provider.
boat is not in the ComputeSDK benchmarks: cold_start_ms, burst_tti_ms, dax_s unknown.

Plan fee is 100% usage credit but expires monthly (effective $20/month minimum); overage bought as $20 packs that never expire. Engine fee_is_credit=true models this; pack residue (<$20) carried to next month is not modelled.
Trial plan (trial_only) is one-time 25 h (~$0.90 of default time; if metered in default-seconds, small would get 50 h), 2 concurrent, small/default, TTL <= 2 h; it cannot be extended with paid usage.

No idle auto-stop: TTL counts from creation/resume (default 1 h; forks reset to 1 h). Idle-but-running bills full size rate; --no-auto-stop (paid only) runs until stopped. FAQ: "Boat has no idle timer. The auto-stop TTL counts from creation or resume, never from last activity" (https://docs.boat.dev/faq.md, 2026-09-28), so auto_stop_idle=false is correct.
Organization seats multiply concurrency and start limits (one pooled budget); seat price unpublished (per_seat null).
Egress included up to 2 TB per sandbox per month (egress_free_gib=2000 is per sandbox, engine treats as account-wide = conservative); price beyond 2 TB unpublished.
Public IP is 'dedicated IPv6 or IPv4' - IPv4 not guaranteed (ipv4_available null) and it changes on resume; no charge either way.

Snapshots: latest per sandbox free for life of sandbox (FAQ: "Stopped sandboxes are free, and their snapshot is kept for the life of the sandbox." https://docs.boat.dev/faq.md), bounded by the size's data disk; up to 10 named snapshots ("You can keep up to 10"), no expiry (https://docs.boat.dev/snapshots.md). Named-snapshot pricing is not stated beyond that; snapshot_gib_month=0 rests on the FAQ line. Filesystem only (no memory), so resume = reboot.
No extra-disk purchase: disk is fixed per size (12/50/125/251 GB), so disk needs can force upsizing. included_disk_gib=50 refers to default size.
Homepage says 'dedicated 4 vCPU / 8 GB VM-time' while FAQ says 'Sandboxes have shared vCPUs'; treat vCPUs as shared.
EU only (Germany, Finland, France); no US/Asia option; no region multiplier.
Custom environments via named-snapshot templates and setup scripts, not Dockerfile/OCI images (custom_image=false).
Out of balance without auto-pay: 24 h grace, then snapshot+stop. Upgrades prorated immediately; downgrade terms unpublished.
Per-start minimum and whether boot/hydration time is billed are not documented (assumed 0).

Performance: standard machines (AMD Ryzen 9 9950X, "baremetal" class) are the default. A temporary Hetzner fallback (older AMD, 8.88 vs 27.67 runs/s, no /dev/kvm) is used only when standard capacity runs out. Same price either way.
Billing scope: running time only; stopped time is never counted and time past a refused stop is excluded (meter paused), per https://docs.boat.dev/billing.md (verified 2026-09-28).

Start limits per plan (creates, forks and resumes all count): 12/min · 60/h · 200/day on $20, 30 · 210 · 840 on $100, 65 · 420 · 1,680 on $500, 90 · 600 · 2,400 on $2,000 (https://docs.boat.dev/pricing, 2026-09-28); multiplied by seats on an organization. Per-minute and per-day caps are enforced by the estimator; the hourly cap (max_starts_per_hour) is recorded but not yet enforced.

Organization plan fee is per member (plan price x members). Whether the included machine time also scales x members is not stated (concurrency and start ceilings do). If an org subscription is cancelled, leftover packs still run but limits drop to one seat.
Start limits can be lifted for committed accounts (sales); per-member caps (usage, concurrency) available to org owners.

Prepaid balance ('funds') and auto-refill exist besides $20 packs: auto-pay charges the card 'in small automatic increments'. Grace-period overuse is carried as a shortfall and settled on the next payment.

Snapshot retention conflict: docs say the latest snapshot is kept for the life of the sandbox and named snapshots have no expiry, but the Terms of Service (https://boat.dev/terms) say snapshots are 'generally retained for a limited period, currently up to approximately 30 days'. Treat free indefinite retention of stopped sandboxes as documented but not contractual.

fleet.verification: Trial eligibility restrictions; paid plan and payment method required for paid limits and disabling auto-stop. No universal ID/KYC requirement stated; terms reserve additional verification.
fleet.tiers: Trial 2; $20/month 100; $100/month 300; $500/month 1,000; $2,000/month 2,000. Plan payments become usage credit. Organization limits multiply by paid seats; above these limits contact provider.
fleet.notes: boat.dev: published plan upgrades take effect immediately (0 days refers only to ordinary paid upgrades, not custom approval). Creation/fork/resume caps also apply: $20 plan 12/min,60/hour,200/day; $100 30/min,210/hour,840/day; $500 65/min,420/hour,1,680/day; $2,000 90/min,600/hour,2,400/day. A 1,000-machine entitlement is not an instantaneous 1,000-start burst. Trial 25 free hours, max 2-hour TTL; xlarge allocated on request.
